cd /workspace/dev && cat > /tmp/max3.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode
random.seed(17)
# 1 entry, 4096 composed pipe applications (a chain), var-dependent guards,
# long preparation paths.
N_APPS=4096; N_STATES=2000; N_RUNS=300
types=[{"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},{"name":"B","kind":"int","bits":8},
       {"name":"Msg","kind":"string","maxsize":16},
       {"name":"St","kind":"enum","values":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)]}]
mods=[{"name":"e","params":[["a","B"],["st","St"],["msg","Msg"]],"result":["r","Bool"],
       "requires":["lt",["var","a"],["const","B",200]]}]
for i in range(N_APPS):
    mods.append({"name":"f%04d"%i,"params":[["x","B"]],"result":["o","Bool"],
                 "requires":["lt",["var","x"],["const","B",250]]})
pipes=[{"target":"e","filter":"f0000","bind":{"x":"a"}}]
for i in range(1,N_APPS):
    pipes.append({"target":"f%04d"%(i-1),"filter":"f%04d"%i,"bind":{"x":"x"}})
machine={"states":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)],"initial":"s0",
         "state_param":"st","message_param":"msg","transitions":[]}
for i in range(N_STATES-1):
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%i,"to":"s%d"%(i+1),
        "command":"step%05d"%i,"cost":1,"when":None})
for i in range(4000):
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%random.randrange(N_STATES),
        "to":"s%d"%random.randrange(N_STATES),"command":"c%05d"%i,"cost":1+random.randrange(50),
        "when":["lt",["var","a"],["const","B",250]]})
camp={"types":types,"modules":mods,"calls":[],"pipes":pipes,"entries":["e"],
      "machine":machine,"runs":[]}
t=time.time(); plan=kit.run(camp)["plans"][0]
print("compile %.2fs modules %d vars %d"%(time.time()-t,len(plan["modules"]),plan["variables"]))
m=mods[0]
runs=[]
for r in range(N_RUNS):
    params={"a":r%200,"st":"s%d"%random.randrange(N_STATES),
            "msg":([ord(c) for c in "m%d"%r]+[0]*16)[:16]}
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,params,True,0)
    runs.append({"entry":"e","ktest":kit.encode(objs)})
camp["runs"]=runs
data=json.dumps(camp); print("input %.1f MiB"%(len(data)/1048576.))
t=time.time(); out=kit.run(camp); print("full run %.1fs"%(time.time()-t))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x["status"] for x in out["records"]))
print("cmds total",sum(len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"]),
      "max cost",max(c["cost"] for c in out["corpus"]))
PYEOF
time python3 /tmp/max3.py
